evidence_items.locator: Section 3, results subsection 'LLMs struggle with questions about current information'
evidence_items.explanation: FreshLLMs documents difficulty with current facts and examines improvements from supplying search results. It does not establish that absent stable world models cause these failures or connect that mechanism to the January 2026 examples.

Tests in navigation, games, and logic puzzles give evidence consistent with Marcus's concern about unreliable representations. These bounded tasks do not establish a shared cause of breaking-news errors and hallucinations.

evidence_items.publisher: ICLR 2023; author manuscript hosted on arXiv
evidence_items.locator: Abstract; intervention methods described in Section 4
evidence_items.explanation: The Othello study finds a learned board representation that influences predictions, challenging an inference that sequence prediction can only produce surface correlations. A synthetic game model does not establish stable, revisable real-world knowledge in the systems discussed by Marcus.

evidence_items.publisher: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences; abstract indexed by PubMed
evidence_items.locator: Abstract, sentence describing the selective-upweighting intervention
evidence_items.explanation: Repeating selected training examples changes hallucination rates in controlled experiments, providing a concrete statistical mechanism to consider. The study neither measures stable world models nor tests breaking news, so it does not rule Marcus's mechanism in or out.

unresolved_gaps: No located study jointly intervenes on internal world representations and measures both breaking-news errors and hallucinations in relevant models.
No controlled investigation of the specific January 3, 2026 failures was located that separates model knowledge from retrieval, prompting, or other system behavior.
The cited studies do not establish whether the relevant models possess representations meeting both stability and revision criteria.
Study dates are reported at year precision where exact experimental dates are unavailable; publication and version dates are recorded separately.
